get.summary: The slots of a space for a day and a duration
get.description: Every on-the-hour start time that fits the venue's opening hours with that duration and has not started yet, in the club's time; `available` says whether they do not overlap an active booking. Without `date`, today's. `opens` is false if the venue is closed that day.

404.description: The space or its venue is no longer active

get.summary: The courts of a venue that are free over a whole range
get.description: The active spaces of the venue, of the sport and kind if given, with no active bookings overlapping [since, until) on `date`, in the club's time. `until` at 00:00 is midnight. The range must be in the future, of whole hours, from 1 to 4 hours, within the next 7 days and inside the venue's opening hours: otherwise 422 with each field's error.

`upcoming`: the active ones that have not ended, from the nearest to the farthest. `history`: the completed, cancelled and voided ones, from the most recent to the oldest. The total is the one saved when booking.

post.description: `hours` hours from `start_hour` (`HH:MM`, in the club's time) on `date`. Whole hours, from 1 to 4, in the future, within the next 7 days and inside the venue's opening hours; if the same person repeats the same request within five minutes, it returns the booking already made.

post.description: Until the slot starts. The slot becomes free again, the booking moves to the history as cancelled and the confirmation stays in the notification center and goes out by push. Cancelling one the same person already cancelled answers the same.

post.description: Another court of the same kind in the same venue, another day or another slot, with the same duration. The previous slot is freed only if the new one is taken; the booking keeps its number and the total becomes the space's current price. Repeating a change already made answers the same.

get.description: All users, all venues. Filters by status (`active`, `completed` or `voided`; without a filter it also brings those cancelled by their user), venue, sport, date range and text (user, venue or space); pages by 20 with `page`, from the most recent to the oldest. It changes nothing.

403.description: Only an administrator reads the global history
Only an administrator reads the detail of any booking

404.description: There is no booking with that number

post.description: Until the slot starts. `space_id` and `starts_at` are the court and the slot the administrator saw: if the booking is no longer there, it answers 409. The slot becomes free again and the booking keeps the reason, who voided it and when. Repeating a voiding already done by the same administrator with the same reason answers the same. It notifies whoever booked, with the reason, without repeating the notice.
